name: TEagle Prospective Benchmark Set
description: Benchmark scope This registration specifies a prospective, task-matched comparison of TEagle 4.1.0 with external software for transposable-element analysis and associated primer, PCR, curation and workflow tasks. The protocol defines 18 tasks with fixed inputs, scientific truth, software conditions, outcome states and reporting rules. Comparisons are made within compatible tasks; no pooled accuracy score across unrelated tasks is defined. Software and tasks Classification: Source-label concordance and separately supported biological identity propositions, with conditions for RepeatClassifier, TEsorter, PASTEClassifier/PASTEC and DeepTE. Terminal structure and domains: Constructed and biological LTR/TIR evidence, including GenomeTools LTRharvest and TIRvish; task-specific nucleotide and protein domain conditions involving HMMER, InterProScan and RPS-BLAST/RPSTBLASTN. Model families and supported input types are distinguished explicitly. Primer design and PCR: Primer3 shared-backend parity, NCBI Primer-BLAST hosted conditions, and fixed-primer product reconstruction with UCSC isPcr, MFEprimer and SeqKit amplicon. Constructed sequence-binding truth and the published biological assay are reported separately. Curation and engineering: Compatible library-curation conditions, integrated workflows, evidence-state and export checks, four-guest deployment, and matched-task resource measurements.
